dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop (O-shaped) and open-loop (C-shaped) structures are visible on the mid-lateral surface. The perimeters consist of high-contrast white pixel clusters bordering dark grey pixels, showing a sharp gradient transition over a 3-5 pixel width. Edges are non-linear and jagged.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid white pixel clusters is observed on the lower lateral and posterior regions. These blobs lack an internal intensity gradient and are distributed in a stochastic, non-uniform pattern along the ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent mid-lateral annuli form an obtuse triangle. The angle formed at the most dorsal centroid is approximately 110 degrees, connecting to two ventral-lateral centroids.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated high-intensity white semi-circle is present directly below the right ocular orbit, exhibiting a high local contrast ratio relative to the surrounding facial fur.
